confirmed_defects.scope: Installed TabPFN 2.0.9 distribution API, not yet an established cause of baseline scientific failure
confirmed_defects.defect: FullSupportBarDistribution.forward/mean use half-normal endpoint tails, while inherited cdf/icdf and sample use finite uniform endpoint bars.
confirmed_defects.constructed_witness: With borders [-1,0,1,2] and probabilities [0.9,0.05,0.05], API mean is -0.9305036273; finite-sampler expected mean is -0.35 and 20,000 CPU draws average -0.3515135383. Requested quantile p=0.1 has density-implied CDF 0.4939276980.
confirmed_defects.causality_limit: Actual endpoint mass and target transforms for baseline queries must be measured before attributing any original gate error to this mismatch. Restoring half-normal sampling might improve or worsen accuracy.
confirmed_defects.unused_related_defect: pdf returns exp(positive NLL), the inverse of the density; original baseline does not call pdf, so this is excluded as a baseline failure cause.

not_found: No scientific prior, forward/noise, support, order, full-joint context, held-out conditioning, or label-leakage defect was found by the independent checks. A separate installed SDK sampling/density mismatch is confirmed below; its baseline impact is not yet measured.
confirmed_checks: Independent Gaussian prior, quadratic mechanical/affine acoustic forward and absolute-noise likelihood match the source numerically.
Acoustic maps are 1.4*a_a1 + 3.1, 1.55*a_a2 + 3.2, and 1.7*a_a3 + 3.3; six sigma coordinates are standard deviations, not variances.
Training banks use the full correlated joint prior. Held-out central selection does not alter the inference prior.
Unbounded Gaussian physics coordinates need no extra support truncation. Whole-vector finite plus six bounded-noise checks match the declared support.
All 24 query/context/order/checkpoint/settings/seed/source/sample-payload bindings and all 8 parent/refined-grid chains match.
Training features are raw observations followed by earlier bank parameters; query features are observations followed by earlier generated parameters, with no true held-out parameter input.
Rejection uses complete vectors, max_iter_rejection=None; no clipping, timeout filler, or uncorrected log-density calibration is used.
demonstrated_patterns: All 155 definite marginal CDF failures occur in global/mechanical coordinates: 18 globals, 92 mechanical coefficients, 45 mechanical noise. The final 144 acoustic cells meet this marginalCDF criterion.

Acoustic-noise posterior is almost unchanged from the prior (median reference/priorSD 0.99735; prior-referenceCDF witness difference 0.00796), while mechanical-noise posteriors are informative (median SD/priorSD 0.52813; prior-referenceCDF witness difference 0.29753). Acoustic-noise agreement is therefore a weak-information control.

Acoustic locations are strongly informed (median referenceSD/priorSD 0.15163) and still meet the marginalCDF criterion at all 72 cells. A simple monotonic later-stage-error story cannot explain the group pattern.

Bias patterns are largely case-dependent across the three banks: for mechanical targets, between-case fractions are 0.710–0.990 in the balanced descriptive bias decomposition. Bank changes are nevertheless much larger than conditional empirical sampling SE.

Mechanical posterior dependence can be wrong beyond marginal scale changes: worst variance inflation in reference-whitened 3-coefficient space 11.98, curve-signalSD inflation 3.44, and expected residual-energy ratio 3.75. These are descriptive covariance diagnostics, not new gate criteria.
Only 91 of 154 point-bias-failure cells have mean errors directed toward the prior mean. Uniform shrinkage toward the prior is therefore insufficient as a sole explanation.
plausible_hypotheses_not_proven: The raw10-point mechanical representation leaves the frozen tabular regressor to infer residual energy and coupled polynomial coefficients from redundant noisy features.
Finite 4096-world prior coverage interacts with a conditional task-prior mismatch in the frozen regression checkpoint.
Within-mechanical-block autoregressive propagation may amplify conditional approximation errors; late-stage acoustic success does not exclude this local mechanism.
The current physical coefficient basis is correlated/anisotropic, and bounded-noise targets may be awkward for the frozen predictive distribution head.

limitations: No new model call or alternative representation evaluated.
Reference inverse-CDF quantiles and covariance whitening are diagnostic, not additional gate criteria.
Case/bank decomposition includes Monte Carlo sampling and numerical effects; empirical MC SE is conditional on the fitted PFN and assumes independent complete draws.
Simple monotonic stage-error accumulation is testable as a descriptive pattern; this cannot exclude within-block autoregressive propagation.
No root cause follows from correlation or group concentration alone.
compute: CPU-only diagnostic using saved data/moments/tables; 0 additional GPU-hours from this worker.
sdk_semantics_followup: Before any statistical candidate change, inspect actual per-stage endpoint probabilities and transformations, then decide whether a narrowly isolated reconstruction-consistency experiment is warranted. The constructed proof is not that experiment.
